messages:
incident-bot: 🚨 PAGING: High GPU queue length and autoscaler failures in cluster 'inference-usw2'. Severity: P1. Queue depth > 12k; token throttling observed. Please acknowledge.
jamal (oncall): acknowledged. I'm looking. tag me if you hit anything customer-facing.
maria (infra): seeing spike in PodPending for nodeSelector gpu=true. Autoscaler logs show repeated 'failed to launch nodegroup' for nodegroup-gpu-2.
chris (mlops): user-facing latency up ~3x for realtime endpoints. Embedding jobs queued. Which error in autoscaler?
maria (infra): AWS error: "InvalidLaunchTemplateSpecification: The specified launch template version does not exist" on scaleout attempts. also some IAM Deny when creating instance-profile: "AccessDenied: iam:PassRole"
jamal (oncall): oh, launch template mismatch + iam passrole deny - combo. Did we recently rotate launch template? @deploy-bot any recent rollout?
deploy-bot: deploys: 1 new launch template v29 applied to nodegroup-gpu-2 at 1887654000 by infra-deploy. No canary failures reported.
chris (mlops): we pushed quantized model rollout yesterday; shouldn't touch infra.
jamal (oncall): okay next steps: 1) confirm which LT versions autoscaler expects; 2) attempt manual scaleup of a fallback nodegroup; 3) page infra owners; 4) notify support/customer-impact.
sophia (support): customer-facing impact: several production customers are seeing errors on generation and increased 429s. I can start templated message once we have ETA.
maria (infra): checking ASG and nodegroup states. kubectl: "kubectl get nodes | grep gpu" shows current GPU nodes 12/60 capacity used. Pending pods: 2370.
maria (infra): autoscaler-controller logs snippet: ```E0301 12:34:12 autoscaler.go:442] scaleup failed: error creating AutoScalingGroup: InvalidLaunchTemplateSpecification: Launch template ID lt-0abcd v=29 not found```
jamal (oncall): that explains it. Where was v29 created? Maybe in another account/region. Can we point autoscaler to v28?
maria (infra): autoscaler config references launchTemplate: auto: use latest. but ASG expects explicit version, autoscaling group template was updated to v29 but the template wasn't published to the managed nodegroup role because infra job errored earlier — I see a rollover error at 1887653500 but it didn't fail loudly.
chris (mlops): is there a quick rollback? manual patching of ASG to v28?
maria (infra): trying manual replace: aws autoscaling update-auto-scaling-group --auto-scaling-group-name nodegroup-gpu-2 --launch-template 'LaunchTemplateId=lt-0abcd,Version=28'
maria (infra): got IAM error: "User: arn:aws:sts::123:assumed-role/autoscaler-role cannot pass role arn:aws:iam::123:role/NodeInstanceProfileRole"
jamal (oncall): so autoscaler role lost iam:PassRole. regressions from role policy change. Who touched IAM policies?
deploy-bot: recent iam changes: infra-iam-sync applied policy snapshot at 1887653000, owner: infra-iam-team.
maria (infra): I'm escalating to infra-iam-team. In parallel I can create a temporary node via manual EC2 run-instances using an existing launch template v28 and attach it to ASG? Might be faster to register node manually to drain queue.
chris (mlops): yes, small manual node will reduce gating for hot endpoints. Add taints? note some pods require specific taint tolerations.
jamal (oncall): do it — we need immediate capacity. Create 2x p4d-like nodes (or p3 if p4 unavailable) to handle the heaviest loads.
maria (infra): spinning up manual instances now with LT v28. CLI: ```aws ec2 run-instances --launch-template LaunchTemplateId=lt-0abcd,Version=28 --count 2```
maria (infra): started, but kube bootstrap failing: kubelet can't join due to cloud-init referencing nodegroup tags that our bootstrap script expects (managed node labels). I'll override and manually add node object.
kube-ops-bot: detected new instance i-0f1a2b3c; registering with cluster via kubeadm token.
maria (infra): node joined but tainted with gpu-unmanaged:NoSchedule (our manual bootstrap sets unmanaged taint). Need to remove taint for inference pods to schedule.
jamal (oncall): remove taint for now: kubectl taint nodes i-0f1a2b3c gpu-unmanaged:NoSchedule-
maria (infra): taint removed. Pods scheduling. Pod logs show model server initializing. Good. Queue depth dropping ~6% in 5m.
sophia (support): messaging: "We've deployed temporary capacity to mitigate throttling while infra fixes autoscaling. There may still be intermittent 429s; ETA unknown." Sending to affected customers.
chris (mlops): we should also temporarily disable aggressive batching on realtime to reduce bursty queue growth. Can someone flip the runtime flag?
jamal (oncall): I can set a traffic-shed throttle: PATCH /config/routes/realtime { max_inflight: 300 } — applying now.
jamal (oncall): applied. traffic reduced. 95th pct latency improving.
maria (infra): infra-iam-team confirmed a policy rollback that removed iam:PassRole from autoscaler-role. They are reapplying missing action now — estimated 12m to propagate.
deploy-bot: autoscaler events: next scale attempt in ~3m. It will attempt with v29 unless we patch.
maria (infra): propose permanent fix: update autoscaler role policy to restore iam:PassRole and add monitoring that validates launch template exists before promotion. Filing infra ticket INFRA-4321.
jamal (oncall): for now: keep manual nodes online until autoscaler can self-heal. set TTL 2h. Maria, can you tag them with temporary-managed=true?
maria (infra): tagged. also adding a scaling-target config to prefer other nodegroups while nodegroup-gpu-2 is unhealthy.
chris (mlops): ML teams will pause non-critical batch jobs to free GPUs. Posting notice in #eng-ml.
sophia (support): customer update sent. no critical data loss. One large customer reported retries failing and offered temporary token credits.
jamal (oncall): handoff plan: I'm staying for next 30 minutes to confirm autoscaler success. If v29 scale attempt succeeds after IAM fix, remove manual nodes gracefully and revert traffic-shed. If not, escalate to oncall manager.
maria (infra): IAM policy applied at 1887655200. autoscaler attempted scale at 1887655260; logs show successful CreateFleet -> instance launch. New managed nodes joining now.
kube-ops-bot: 3 new nodes registered: ip-10-0-11-23, ip-10-0-11-24, ip-10-0-11-25.
maria (infra): autoscaler used v29 successfully. Pending pods draining onto new managed nodes. Scheduling normalizing.
jamal (oncall): removing manual nodes now to avoid double-billing. kubectl drain i-0f1a2b3c && terminate-instance i-0f1a2b3c
maria (infra): manual nodes drained and terminated. Queue length back to baseline. Customer-facing metrics improving.
sophia (support): updating customers: mitigation complete, monitoring. Thanks team.
jamal (oncall): closing loop: root cause = IAM policy rollback that prevented autoscaler from passing instance profile role + a partial launch template rollout that created v29 without proper publication. Action items: INFRA-4321 (LT validation + publish guard), INFRA-4322 (iam policy drift alert), OPS-502 (runbook update). I'll open incident postmortem draft.
chris (mlops): add a note about runtime emergency knobs we toggled.
maria (infra): thanks all. handing off to next oncall; oncall shift: @jamal -> @chris in 30m.
jamal (oncall): handing off, leaving notes in PagerDuty. If anything else spikes ping me. :thumbsup:
